body:
#### PR description:

This PR adds the following changes for the rereco of the Run3 PbPb HIForward data using the UPC era:
- Relaxes the strip cluster threshold
- Standardize the UPC egamma regression across all years.

#### PR validation:

Tested with workflows 141.901,142.901,143.901,144.901,180.0,180.1,181.0,181.1,182.0,182.1,183.0,183.1

No backport needed
